arguments.text: Good start. Settle now to steady race effort, long way to go.

6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: near-even effort at about sustainable shaft power (~195-200 W pod, boat CP 131 W) so the pod reserve reaches near zero only at the finish. Start was hot (255 W pod at 1 min, reserve 73%). Ease to settle, then hold. Compare out vs back legs for current. Final sprint (finish) from about 400-500 m to go if reserve allows. Watch for incidents: rudder weed (speed drops at same power), wind shift, pod drift, radio course changes.

arguments.message: GPS speed well below what pod power should give (beyond current): weed on rudder, wind, or pod drift?
Pod reserve below 20% with more than 1200 m left
Shaft power well above sustainable for 45 s
Shaft power well below sustainable for 60 s: fading, backing off, or pod reading low

arguments.reason: Decide on final sprint timing from reserve

text: Cued ease after hot start (pod 255 W vs 190 CP, reserve 73%); set plan, four watches (drag drop, low reserve, too hot, too low) and a 700 m-to-go wake-up.

arguments.text: Too hot. Ease right off now, smooth and relaxed.

Min 4: first ease (min 1.1) barely followed: pod 230->226 W. Pod reserve 27% at 785 m, sustainable pod ~193 W. Cued firmer ease with pace 160 over ground (leg 1 into -0.13 push). Leg 2 (back, south) should be helped ~+0.13: ground pace for ~193 W there is about 150. Re-cue hold after turn.

arguments.reason: After turn: check ease took, re-cue hold with leg-2 pace (~150 over ground if helped)

text: Cued ease to 160 over ground: pod 225 W vs sustainable 193, reserve 27% at 785 m; wake after the turn to set leg-2 pace.

arguments.text: Min 4.8: paddler says 8/10, hard but holding. Pod still 222 W after two ease cues (not followed). Pod reserve 18%. Either CP is underestimated or they will blow up; watch reserve_low_s and speed fade. Next: firmer ease/hold cue after the turn.

text: no cue: cue gate closed for 15 s; paddler 8/10 and still at 222 W pod, will cue again after the turn (wake at 345 s).

arguments.text: Reserve nearly empty. Ease to 2:30 pace, breathe, stay long.

arguments.reason: Check ease to 150 took on leg 2; reserve near empty, watch for forced slowdown

text: Cued ease to 2:30 over ground on helped leg 2: pod 210 W, pod reserve 7%, sustainable 191 W.

arguments.reason: Just after turn 2 into leg 3 (against current): re-cue pace target for into-current leg (~163 over ground at CP) so old 150 target does not make them overcook
Reserve at zero: check for forced slowdown or whether CP is underestimated

arguments.text: Min 7.3: third ease (pace 150, leg 2 helped) partly followed: pod 215->202, now 196 W, GPS 3.44. Pod reserve 0.3%, boat reserve 4%. Fade -4% at same rate (power drop, not drag: push_local ~ push_along). Leg 3 (north, against ~0.15) ground pace at CP ~163.

text: no cue: pod now 196 W, close to sustainable 190 after the ease; reserve at zero, rechecking in 80 s and at the next turn.

arguments.text: Likely weed. One quick back-stroke to clear rudder, then steady.

Min 8.3: paddler said boat heavy, something on rudder. Evidence: pod steady 196 W but push_local stepped down from ~0.21 to ~0.09-0.10 m/s at race s ~465-480 (leg 2, push_along 0.16 unchanged) and speed through water fell 3.27->3.14. Cued clear_rudder at min 8.4. Check: push_local should return to ~0.2 on this leg (or match push_along) if cleared; if not, cue clear_rudder again.

text: Cued clear_rudder: paddler reported heavy boat and push_local stepped down ~0.11 m/s at steady pod power, consistent with weed.

arguments.reason: Judge whether clear_rudder worked: push_local back near push_along (~+0.15) on leg 2? If still low, clear again before turn

text: no cue: clear_rudder only 3 s ago and readings include the back-stroke dip; judging in 45 s.

arguments.text: Min 9.6: rudder cleared (back-stroke seen, speed dip 36%); push_local back to +0.26, speed water 3.34, fade -1%. Pod reserve model has read 0 since ~min 7.5 while pod held 196-204 W with no forced slowdown: evidence pod CP (190) or reserve (14.4 kJ) is underestimated. Keep watching; consider set_critical_power if they keep holding ~200 W without fading.

text: no cue: rudder cleared and speed restored; turn in 90 m, will set leg-3 pace at the post-turn wake-up.

arguments.reason: Pod reserve model read 0 from min 7.5 to 10.3 while pod held 196-204 W with no forced slowdown, and paddler effort fell from 8/10 to 7/10: pre-race CP looks about 6 % low.

arguments.text: 6000 m, 6 legs of 1000 m out-and-back (odd legs north into ~0.15 m/s push, even legs south helped ~0.15). Start was hot; paddler settled at ~200 W pod. CP corrected at min 10.3 to pod 202 W / boat 139 W (reserve model had read 0 for 3 min with no forced slowdown, effort 7/10). Plan: hold ~200-207 W pod (their own steady effort) through legs 3-5, no pace targets that ignore current. Use reserve readings from the corrected model; if pod power fades below ~190 at steady rate or paddler says 9+, ease. Final sprint (finish) from ~500 m to go if pod reserve > 15 %, else ~300 m. Weed on rudder happened once (min 8, cleared with clear_rudder): if push_local drops ~0.1 below push_along at steady pod power, clear again.

Min 10.4: paddler 7/10 hard but holding. Legs: leg1 out 225 W pod 3.25 GPS; leg2 back 202 W 3.38 GPS (incl weed). Set CP pod 202 / boat 139 (1 of 3 uses): pod reserve now 39 %, boat 44 %. If reserve drains toward 0 again without slowdown, CP still low; if paddler slows hard, CP set too high.

text: no cue: paddler steady at ~200 W pod, 7/10; corrected CP to 202 W pod since reserve model read empty with no slowdown; plan updated.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, long and smooth. You are on good pace.

Min 11.4: paddler said legs going, close to limit. Pod rose 202->222 W over race s 630-675 after turn into leg 3 (against ~0.15), GPS 3.05->3.13 (about consistent with real extra effort, not clearly pod drift). Corrected pod reserve 32 %, sustainable 206 W. Cued ease (no pace target). Check pod back to ~205 in 60-90 s.

arguments.reason: Check ease took (pod ~205 W) and paddler is not fading; re-check pod vs GPS for drift

text: Cued gentle ease: paddler near limit and pod up to 222 W vs sustainable 206 after the turn into the current.

arguments.message: Boat power share of pod power fell below 0.615 (was ~0.67-0.69): pod drifting high, tired blade, or extra drag

arguments.text: Min 13: boat/pod power ratio leg1 0.69, leg2 0.67, leg3 0.635-0.65; push_local minus push_along was +0.07 leg1, +0.04 leg2, -0.03 leg3. Small drift: pod reading high, tired blade, or wind. Boat model says at CP (137 vs 139, reserve 42 %); pod says 210 vs 202 (reserve 25 %). Ease at 11.5 barely followed (216->213). GPS speed steady 3.1 into current. Added watch pod_vs_boat.

text: no cue: pod 210 W close to sustainable 205, boat model at CP, speed steady; added a watch on pod-vs-boat power share for drift or tired blade.

arguments.reason: Race committee radio at min 14.3: course extended by one leg, finish now at 7000 m.

arguments.text: Committee: one extra leg. Finish now 4200 metres away. Stay steady.

RACE NOW 7000 m (radio min 14.3: one extra leg; set_race_distance done, paddler told 4216 m left). 7 legs of 1000 m out-and-back: odd legs north into ~0.15 m/s push, even legs south helped ~0.15; finish at end of leg 7 (north, into the push). CP corrected at min 10.3 to pod 202 W / boat 139 W. Paddler said legs going / close to limit at min 11.3; at min 14.3 pod fell to ~189 W. Plan: hold near sustainable shaft power (about 200-205 W) through legs 4-6, no pace targets that ignore current. If pod fades below ~185 at steady rate, reassure/hold rather than push. Final sprint (finish) from ~500 m to go if pod reserve > 15 %, else ~300 m. Weed on rudder once (min 8, cleared): if push_local drops ~0.1 below push_along at steady pod power, clear_rudder again.

Min 14.3: radio extended course to 7000 m; set_race_distance 7000 and cue tell 4216 m left. Pod fell 207->189 W with speed water 3.22->3.12 (push_local ~ push_along, so not weed): fatigue or late reaction to ease. Pod reserve 24 %.
